versions.changelog: v1.4.0: ① Added author QQ 965621229. ② Rewrote description to highlight clear, intuitive interactions and one-click publish-to-share. ③ Added "What it is / Who it's for" overview for beginners. ④ Template now ships a clickable mini-program demo with working Interaction Specs. ⑤ Includes a full runnable example (team group-order).

prd-html-prototype 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Create PRD authoring workflow combining structured document and interactive HTML prototype in a single file with a big-tech minimal visual style.
- Supports diagnosing and completing PRD drafts, and adding interactive prototypes featuring tab navigation, sticky TOC, and admin/miniprogram screens.
- Provides a ready-to-use HTML template with built-in tab switching, animated indicators, sticky navigation, and visual norms.
- Guides deployment to GitHub Pages with cache-busting support and .nojekyll configuration.
- Includes resources for PRD structure, deployment steps, and a reusable HTML skeleton.
